Non reentrant for the same Pdu Id. Parameters (in) Tx Pdu Id Identifier of the PDU to be transmitted Pdu Info Ptr Length of and pointer to the PDU data and pointer to Meta Data. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std _ Return - Type E_ OK: Transmit request has been accepted. E_ NOT_ OK: Transmit request has not been accepted. Description Requests transmission of a PDU. Available via Lin If.h
